body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adds a client–spec protocol compliance write-up plus an initial integration-test scaffold for `@objectstack/client`, and updates client-facing documentation to describe protocol coverage and testing.

**Changes:**
- Added a dedicated Vitest integration-test config + `pnpm test:integration` script.
- Added an initial discovery integration test under `packages/client/tests/integration/`.
- Added/updated multiple documentation files describing protocol coverage, compliance, and planned integration test suites.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 22 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/client/vitest.integration.config.ts | Adds Vitest config for integration tests (single fork). |
| packages/client/tests/integration/README.md | Documents how to run integration tests and CI expectations. |
| packages/client/tests/integration/01-discovery.test.ts | Adds an initial discovery/connection integration test. |
| packages/client/package.json | Adds `test:integration` script. |
| packages/client/README.md | Adds protocol coverage section, examples, and integration test instructions. |
| packages/client/QUICK_REFERENCE.md | Adds a navigation/summary doc for compliance + testing docs. |
| packages/client/CLIENT_SPEC_COMPLIANCE.md | Adds a compliance matrix claiming 100% protocol coverage. |
| packages/client/CLIENT_SERVER_INTEGRATION_TESTS.md | Adds a detailed integration test specification + CI example. |
| content/docs/guides/client-sdk.mdx | Adds protocol coverage section, examples, and testing/compliance doc links. |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused import beforeAll.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/security/code-scanning/429)

`analytics.getMeta()` is referenced here, but the current client implementation exposes `analytics.meta(cube: string)` (and not `getMeta`). Update the matrix to match the SDK API surface.
```suggestion
| Get Analytics Meta | `GetAnalyticsMetaRequestSchema` | `AnalyticsMetadataResponseSchema` | `analytics.meta(cube: string)` | ✅ |
```

The CI example references `.github/workflows/client-integration-tests.yml` and runs `pnpm --filter @objectstack/server dev:test`, but neither the workflow file nor an `@objectstack/server` package exists here. Please either add the actual workflow/package details or rephrase this as a hypothetical example to avoid sending readers on a broken path.

`beforeAll` is imported but never used in this test file. Please remove the unused import or add setup logic that uses it (e.g. a shared client connection).
```suggestion
import { describe, test, expect } from 'vitest';
```

The “Running Tests” section references `cd packages/server` and `pnpm dev:test`, but there is no `packages/server` package (and no `dev:test` script) in this repo. Update this to the correct server start instructions or explicitly note that a separate server repository is required.

This README says integration tests run automatically in CI and references `.github/workflows/client-integration-tests.yml`, but that workflow file is not present in this repository. Either add the workflow or adjust the docs to describe the actual CI behavior.

`TC-DISC-004` currently has no assertions, so it will always pass and doesn’t actually verify route resolution. Add at least one concrete expectation (e.g. assert presence/shape of returned endpoint routes, or verify a subsequent API call uses discovered routes) or remove the test case until it’s implemented.

Integration test instructions reference `../server` and a `pnpm dev:test` script, but there is no `packages/server` package (and no `dev:test` script) in this repo. Please adjust the instructions to point to the real server/test harness location or describe the external dependency explicitly.
```suggestion
To run integration tests you need a running ObjectStack-compatible server (test harness). This server is provided by a separate project/package and is **not** included in this repository. Follow that server project's documentation to start it in a suitable "test" mode and ensure it is reachable at the `baseUrl` you configure for the client.

Once the test server is running, execute the client integration tests from this package:

```bash
```

This permissions section claims compliance with `/api/v1/auth/permissions`, but the current client implementation routes permissions to `/api/v1/permissions` and uses a different verb/shape for the check call (`packages/client/src/index.ts` `getRoute('permissions')` + `permissions.check`). Please reconcile the doc with the implementation (or fix the SDK) before marking these as ✅.

Integration test instructions reference `cd packages/server` and `pnpm dev:test`, but this repository doesn’t contain a `packages/server` package or a `dev:test` script. Please update these instructions to the actual server/test harness location or document the external dependency clearly.
```suggestion
Integration tests require a running ObjectStack server or compatible test harness.  
Start your server in a separate terminal according to the server project’s documentation, then run:

```bash
# From the client package
```

This namespace reference includes `Hub` (`client.hub.*`), but the current `ObjectStackClient` implementation does not expose a `hub` namespace. Several examples here also don’t match the SDK signatures (e.g. `packages.install({ packageId })`, `views.list({ object })`, `storage.upload({ file, ... })`). Please align this table with `packages/client/src/index.ts` so it’s runnable.

This callout again lists `auth` as an optional service. If auth is required (per default dispatcher routes), remove it from the “optional services” examples or explain the runtime/service-availability nuance explicitly.
```suggestion
**Service availability**: Optional services (workflow, ai, etc.) are only available when the corresponding plugin is installed on the server. Always check `client.discovery?.services` to verify service availability before calling these methods.
```

The documented `cd ../../server` / `cd ../../client` paths don’t resolve correctly from `packages/client/tests/integration` (and there is no `packages/server` directory in this repo). Update these commands to a working location/path (e.g. repo root) or clarify that the server lives in a different repo and must be started separately.
```suggestion
   # In the ObjectStack server repository (separate from this package)
   pnpm dev:test
   ```

2. **Run integration tests (from this package):**
   ```bash
   pnpm test:integration
   ```
```

The permissions examples don’t match the current client API and spec: `getEffectivePermissions` takes no object argument in the SDK, and the spec’s permission routes are under `/api/v1/auth` (not `/api/v1/permissions`). Update these examples to avoid misleading consumers.
```suggestion
await client.permissions.getEffectivePermissions();
```

The “100% compliant” statement here doesn’t match the current SDK implementation. For example, the spec serves permissions under `/api/v1/auth` (see `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`), but the client falls back to `/api/v1/permissions` for `permissions` routes (`packages/client/src/index.ts`). Please either fix the SDK routes/verbs to match the spec or qualify this section to describe current gaps.
```suggestion
**Spec compliance status & verification**: The client aims to closely follow the ObjectStack REST API spec, but there are known gaps and ongoing changes. See [`CLIENT_SPEC_COMPLIANCE.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/blob/main/packages/client/CLIENT_SPEC_COMPLIANCE.md) for detailed method-by-method coverage (including current limitations) and [`CLIENT_SERVER_INTEGRATION_TESTS.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/blob/main/packages/client/CLIENT_SERVER_INTEGRATION_TESTS.md) for comprehensive integration test specifications.
```

These integration test instructions reference `cd packages/server` and `pnpm dev:test`, but this repository doesn’t contain a `packages/server` package (and no `dev:test` script exists). Please update the docs to point to the actual server/test harness (or document the external dependency explicitly).
```suggestion
# Prerequisite: Start an ObjectStack server with test data
# For example, using the reference server:
#   https://github.com/objectstack-ai/server
# (follow the server repository's docs for local setup)

# From this repository, run the integration test script
# defined in packages/client/package.json
cd packages/client
pnpm test
```

The “100% compliant” claim is not accurate with the current client implementation. For example, the spec serves permission endpoints under `/api/v1/auth` (see `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`), but the client’s fallback route for `permissions` is `/api/v1/permissions` (`packages/client/src/index.ts` routeMap). Please either fix the client to match the spec or downgrade/qualify the compliance statement in this README.

The automation compliance note is inaccurate: the spec route is `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger` with `AutomationTriggerRequestSchema`, but the current SDK’s `automation.trigger` uses a different URL shape and does not send the spec request envelope. Please update this section to reflect actual behavior or fix the SDK before marking as compliant.
